description: Ex-Esquadrilha da Fumaça T-27 Tucano FAB 1381, the first EDA Tucano to be preserved, inaugurated 22 Jul 2018 with a Smoke Squadron display as a memorial to local pilot Cap. Anderson Amaro Fernandes (killed at Lages 2010). Local press loosely calls it a 'replica' but ABRAPAC and a Feb 2026 compilation identify it as the real airframe; a small aviation museum opened next door in Nov 2021.
museum_name: Praça do Aviador T-27 Tucano, Umirim
